mapper.insert: /** TermsManagementMapper.save */ INSERT INTO TERMS ( TITLE, CONTENTS, CONTENT_TYPE, ORDER_NO, USE_YN, REQUIRE_YN, CREATE_ID, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{contents}, #{contentType}, #{orderNo}, #{useYn}, #{requireYn}, #{createId}, #{createDate} )
mapper.update: /** TermsManagementMapper.update */ UPDATE TERMS SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENTS = #{contents}, CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType}, ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, REQUIRE_YN = #{requireYn}, UPDATE_ID = #{updateId}, UPDATE_DATE = #{updateDate} WHERE TERMS_ID = #{termsId}
mapper.insert: /** TermsManagementMapper.saveUserTermsSearch */ INSERT INTO TERMS_SEARCH ( TERMS_ID, TITLE, CONTENTS, CONTENT_TYPE, ORDER_NO, REQUIRE_YN ) SELECT TERMS_ID, TITLE, CONTENTS, CONTENT_TYPE, ORDER_NO, REQUIRE_YN FROM TERMS WHERE TERMS_ID = #{termsId}
mapper.update: /** TermsManagementMapper.updateUserTermsSearch */ UPDATE TERMS_SEARCH TS, TERMS T SET TS.TITLE = T.TITLE, TS.CONTENTS = T.CONTENTS, TS.CONTENT_TYPE = T.CONTENT_TYPE, TS.ORDER_NO = T.ORDER_NO TS.REQUIRE_YN = T.REQUIRE_YN WHERE TS.TERMS_ID = T.TERMS_ID AND T.TERMS_ID = #{termsId}
